g.text: J & D Reserve · Schema Collection Architecture
Physical PostgreSQL Schema · Application DTOs · GraphQL Contracts · In-Memory Redis Namespaces
J & D Beach House · Barangay Patar, Bolinao, Pangasinan
TIER 1: VALIDATION SCHEMA & DTO COLLECTION (JOI & ZOD)
Client Payload Normalization, Input Sanitization & Defensive Contract Enforcement
TIER 2: API CONTRACT SCHEMA COLLECTION (GRAPHQL SDL & REST ENVELOPES)
Strongly-Typed Interfaces, Query Resolvers, Mutations & Real-Time Subscriptions
type Room { id, name, slug, category, rate_php, rating_avg }
type Reservation { id, guest, room, check_in, nights, total_php }
REST Envelope: { status: 200, data: T, message: String, error: null }
RFC 6585 Headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, Remaining, Reset, Retry-After
TIER 3: RELATIONAL DATABASE SCHEMA COLLECTION (SUPABASE POSTGRESQL 15+)
Foreign Key Topology, Overbooking GiST Exclusion Constraints, RLS Policies & Trigger Recalculators
uuid ref rooms(id) on delete set null
TIER 4: IN-MEMORY STATE & CACHE KEY SCHEMA COLLECTION (REDIS & GCRA)
Sub-Millisecond Read Caching, Key Namespace Hierarchy, LRU Eviction & Dynamic Concurrency Slots
